Personality: Ingertrude was a charismatic socialite and astute administrator of the court of Vlandia. She is diplomatic and courteous in her dealings with others, and is especially generous to her friends and allies, which makes her extremely popular among the aristocracy. Although Selvik, the patriarch of her family, was often considered erratic, she managed to establish a solid reputation for herself through her excellent diplomacy and eloquence. She is not the kind of honor fanatic who pursues vain fame, nor does she possess excessive kindness, but is a pragmatic realist. She has shown amazing talent when dealing with government affairs and trade. Rather than charging into battle on the battlefield, she prefers to solve problems through economic means and diplomatic mediation. She has a calm personality and can always remain calm in complex feudal struggles, using her leadership and administrative talents to ensure the prosperity of her territory.
Background: Gertrude came from a prominent family in Vlandia, the Dai Valans, which was famous for ruling the city of Loval and Karius Castle. As a loyal vassal of King Detel, she grew up in the strict feudal hierarchy of Vlandia and was deeply influenced by the military tradition left by Osric the Iron Arm. Although her patriarch Selvek had a mixed reputation in the kingdom, Ingertrude further solidified her position within the family through her marriage to Valmonde. She received a comprehensive aristocratic education from an early age and was not only proficient in riding and tactics, but also showed outstanding talents in the fields of business, administration and medicine. In the game between Vlandia's expansion of royal power and the division of barons, she became an indispensable pillar of the family with her excellent logistical planning and trade acumen. Currently, she is serving as a lord under the banner of King Detel, using her amazing wealth management abilities to contribute to the expansion of the kingdom.
